sections.title: II. Read the following passage and circle the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.
sections.introHtml:
Leisure activities are things people usually do in their free time for fun and relaxation. Different people enjoy different kinds of leisure activities depending on their interests and personalities. Some teenagers love outdoor activities such as playing football, cycling, going camping, or going for a walk in the park because they can stay healthy, enjoy the fresh air, and make new friends. Others prefer indoor activities like reading books, watching movies, listening to music, or playing computer games to relax and entertain themselves after a busy school day.

In many families, weekends are a wonderful time for leisure. Parents and children can spend more quality time together. They may go on a picnic, visit grandparents, go shopping, or simply cook a special meal at home and enjoy it. Spending time together helps family members feel closer, share their feelings, and become happier.

Leisure activities are very important because they help us relax after studying or working hard. They also make our lives more interesting, reduce stress, and help us learn new things.

IV. Writing (80–100 words)

Topic: How teenagers should deal with stress

Teenagers often face a lot of stress from school and daily life, so it is important for them to know how to relax. First, they should turn off computers and smartphones for a while to avoid spending too much time online. They can go outside, enjoy nature, or do some exercise to feel better. Getting enough sleep by going to bed early also helps the body and mind stay healthy. Moreover, talking with friends or teachers can make them feel supported and less stressed.
